record_title: Two-commutator transfer for self-similar factorization ideals
provenance: The proof combines a complemented factorization R=ST with a shift-corner commutator identity on a countable self-sum of the factor space, producing an explicit two-commutator decomposition whose factors stay in the same factorization ideal.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The shift-corner mechanism is prior art; the novelty claim is restricted to the two-commutator transfer and the stated applications. Because the proof is a short synthesis of known ingredients, an equivalent observation under different terminology in older commutator literature remains a material priority risk. The theorem does not decide whether one commutator always suffices.
